title: AttestArc knowledge-plane trust metadata (attestation model)
description: Two documents anchor the verified-knowledge plane. (1) trust-anchor.json ships inside the SSH-signed skill release and is the external root of trust: it pins the Sigstore/OIDC identity (repo + signer workflow + issuer) that a downloaded knowledge bundle's build-provenance attestation MUST match. It lives outside any downloaded bundle and is never overwritten by refresh. (2) manifest.json describes one atomic knowledge release, pinning every pack by sha256+size with a monotonic version and a chain to the previous manifest; it is the artifact the release workflow attests (see scripts/knowledge_verify.py, .github/workflows/release-knowledge.yml). The homemade root/timestamp/snapshot/targets role files are removed: trust no longer derives from metadata the bundle supplies about itself.

repo.description: owner/repo that must have produced the attestation

signer_workflow.description: workflow path that must have signed (informational; the SAN check uses the per-artifact regexps below)

signer_workflow_refs.description: informational map of artifact kind -> reviewed git ref (e.g. {"bundle": "refs/tags/knowledge-v<N>", "revocation": "refs/heads/main"})

cert_identity_regexp_bundle.description: SAN identity regexp a knowledge BUNDLE (manifest/archive) attestation must match; binds the trailing @refs/tags/knowledge-v<N>

cert_identity_regexp_revocation.description: SAN identity regexp a REVOCATION attestation must match; binds the trailing @refs/heads/main

cert_identity_regexp.description: DEPRECATED legacy combined regexp; used only as a fallback when the per-artifact keys are absent

bootstrap_manifest.description: path (relative to the package knowledge root) of the in-package bootstrap manifest

client_state_dir.description: directory holding the persistent trusted-state.json (outside any repo)

snapshots_dir.description: directory holding installed refreshed snapshots (separate from client state)

name.description: path relative to the knowledge root, e.g. bootstrap/github-actions.jsonl

version.description: monotonic release version; a client rejects version <= its highest trusted version

expires.description: short TTL (freeze protection); a downloaded manifest past expiry is rejected, an in-package bootstrap snapshot past expiry warns but remains the last-known-good floor

prev_digest.description: sha256 of the previous manifest.json (chain), or null for the first release

mode.description: OPTIONAL and defensive: a downloaded bundle declaring 'bootstrap' is rejected. Bootstrap trust is conferred only by being the immutable in-package snapshot, never by a self-declared field.
